nodes.label: OIDC Offline Access
nodes.rationale: The offline_access scope and role are required to prevent Offline user session not found errors and to support long-running sessions.

nodes.label: PKCE S256
nodes.rationale: The setup specifies S256 to match the frontend authorization-code configuration.

nodes.label: Cluster-Global Observability
nodes.rationale: Per-process Go runtime and request metrics are intentionally excluded because public load-balanced scrapes across multiple backend replicas can be misleading.

nodes.label: External Secret References
nodes.rationale: Secret creation is disabled by default for safety; deployments are intended to use external Secrets or Vault.

nodes.label: Optional Vault Secret Integration
nodes.rationale: Vault support is optional and disabled by default.
